QuestInfo.name: A Warrior of Perion
QuestInfo.0: Christopher has something to say before he heads back to the Excavation Site. Famous last words?
QuestInfo.1: Christopher told you that Stands With Bulls in #m102030300# wants to deliver something to town, so Christopher wants you to help him out. Since Christopher can't be trusted to find his way, go to #m102030200# and see Stands With Bulls.
QuestInfo.2: You met Stands With Bulls in #m102030200#.

0.0: Oh, I almost forgot! Stands with Bulls at #m102030200# wanted you to visit him. He's keeping watch over the town right now. I should go back to the excavation site now. You just need to go left from here to get to #m102030200#. Right?

yes.0: Off I go to the excavation site! It's south, right? Near Kerning Square?

no.0: Wait, what? No! You have to go. If you don't he'll think I didn't tell you. And if he thinks that... (He starts sweating.)

yes.0: This is a dangerous place. You should be careful.

npc.0: You can find Stands with Bulls at #m102030200#.
